reviewerPrecisionRecallAnalysis.conclusion: Agreement is useful for routing, not truth. It raises frozen precision from 96.75% union to 98.83% intersection and full-corpus precision from 94.67% to 99.52%, but still leaves 9 frozen and 19 full-corpus agreed false positives. Disagreement is enriched for errors but contains correct relationships, so it must be reviewed rather than rejected.

reviewerAgreementDisagreementAnalysis.routingConclusion: Both-agree plus no risk flag is a candidate auto-accept shape, but agreement alone cannot auto-accept. Any disagreement must route to review.

reviewerFalsePositiveTaxonomy.population: The 28 INCORRECT reviewer-union relationships in the frozen 36-recipe benchmark; the two deterministic-only incorrect candidates in the 863-candidate V10A pool are excluded.

mutuallyExclusiveCategories.basis: Serving-only continuation, process material, wrong lexical alias/not-established row, or a blending instruction whose source group excludes the candidate target.
A raw row was carried into a later operation on an assembled dish/mixture although the benchmark does not treat that row as independently active.

reviewerFalsePositiveTaxonomy.conclusion: Twenty-five of 28 false positives fall into four repeated, source-observable risk families; three require semantic policy judgment. The concentration supports a routing classifier, but not an automatic rejection layer.

v10gRoleAnalysis.option1AutomaticSafeAcceptEvidence: RETAIN, conditionally. Zero false accepts across all 30 frozen incorrect candidates makes the frontier promising for reducing review, but the exact acceptance contract must be extracted and revalidated before production use.
v10gRoleAnalysis.option2RiskSuppressionEvidence: DO NOT USE AS A GLOBAL VETO. V9/V10 safety and arbiter layers repeatedly removed many correct relationships.
v10gRoleAnalysis.option3ReviewPrioritizationMetadata: RETAIN. V10G/V10D basis, semantic class, reviewer votes, component membership, lifecycle, and quantity facts are useful reviewer context.
v10gRoleAnalysis.option4Discard: REJECTED; the zero-FP evidence is valuable even though the mapper program stopped.
v10gRoleAnalysis.importantCaveat: The measured 773-accept frontier is a frozen combined V10D-plus-rescue result. The V10G rescue rule itself is deterministic, while the V10D experiment included 392 bounded arbiter decisions. It must not be represented as an already-proven standalone deterministic router.

alternativeB.reason: Zero review leaves 228 observed full-corpus false positives in the union. Adding complete review becomes Alternative D.

fullCorpusProjectionIfFrozenV10gRateGene.assumption: Applies the frozen 10.2207% review rate and 58.33% recipe-review incidence to the existing full-corpus candidate count. This is a planning estimate, not a measured full-corpus result.

alternativeC.conclusion: A narrow reviewed-routing contract plausibly reduces steady-state review to roughly two relationships per recipe, but the exact full-corpus burden is unproven and must be measured before activation.

futureIngestionArchitecture.name: AI reviewer union with versioned evidence/risk routing and human approval of uncertainty
flow: Finalize exact recipe content
Parse canonical ordered ingredient and instruction arrays
Compute sourceHash
Run blind reviewer A and blind reviewer B independently
Normalize and union candidate relationships without treating either output as truth
Attach deterministic source, lifecycle, component-boundary, quantity, vote, and V10G-support evidence
Route each candidate to AUTO_ACCEPT_HIGH_CONFIDENCE, REVIEW_REQUIRED, or AUTO_REJECT_CLEAR_ERROR
Human approves or rejects every REVIEW_REQUIRED relationship and checks completeness prompts
Materialize one immutable approved map
Persist approved map plus version and provenance
Cooking Mode performs a source-hash/version read and makes zero AI calls
futureIngestionArchitecture.candidateGeneration: Two blind whole-recipe reviewers receive the same exact source independently. Union maximizes discovery; normalized candidate IDs make retries and comparison deterministic.
futureIngestionArchitecture.nondeterminismHandling: Store each normalized reviewer output and candidate-set hash as proposal evidence. A repeated run creates a new attempt; it never silently overwrites an approved map or becomes truth by majority alone.

routingStates.AUTO_ACCEPT_HIGH_CONFIDENCE: Allowed only by a versioned contract with frozen zero-FP evidence, reviewer support, exact source grounding, and no risk flag. Reviewer agreement alone is insufficient. Initially this state should remain disabled for any relation class not explicitly proven by the routing contract.
routingStates.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Any reviewer disagreement, deterministic risk flag, component/prepared-component relation, ambiguous lifecycle/reference, unsupported class, or incompleteness concern.
routingStates.AUTO_REJECT_CLEAR_ERROR: Structural impossibility only: out-of-range/header index, duplicate candidate, source-hash mismatch, malformed evidence, or relationship unsupported by the exact parsed source. Semantic risk is routed to review rather than auto-rejected.

provenanceStored: human decision and reviewer identity where applicable
futureIngestionArchitecture.mapVersioning: Approved maps are immutable and source-bound. A new sourceHash or mapping-contract version creates a new proposal/version; previous approved versions remain audit evidence and are never mutated in place.
futureIngestionArchitecture.retryBehavior: Bounded retry only for transport/schema failure using an idempotency key. A successful but different semantic output is stored as a separate attempt and routed normally; retries do not cherry-pick a preferred map.
futureIngestionArchitecture.failureBehavior: Fail closed: no proposal becomes approved. Keep the last approved map only when its sourceHash still matches; otherwise Cooking Mode receives no unapproved mapping. Recipe save/publish policy may surface a pending-review state, but no provisional AI result drives runtime.
futureIngestionArchitecture.recipeEditInvalidation: Only edits that change canonical parsed ingredients, instructions, or ordering change sourceHash. Such edits mark the prior map stale and trigger two fresh reviewer calls plus routing/review. Metadata-only edits do not recompute the map.
futureIngestionArchitecture.runtime: Validate schema, supported version, approved status, sourceHash, and structure; then read the persisted approved map. Runtime makes zero AI calls and performs no mapping write.

existingCorpusRemediationArchitecture.policy: Use a stricter, one-time full-review policy than future ingestion because 228 recipes can be remediated offline once and the quality target includes 100% precision.
flow: Lock exact source recipes and source hashes
Generate high-recall proposals offline with two blind reviewers
Human-review complete proposed maps and source completeness, including prepared components under a separate gate
Materialize immutable approved mapping values
Create sorted migration manifest with per-row sourceHash, approvedMapHash, provenance, and preconditions
Lock manifest and approval evidence by SHA-256
Run read-only dry-run against live documents
Require a separate explicit production-apply prompt
Apply only exact approved mapping values with update-time preconditions; no AI and no recomputation
Read back exact maps, source hashes, validator results, and non-map-field hashes
Run a post-apply zero-write dry-run
Retain before-map hashes/values and an exact reverse manifest for rollback evidence

finalArchitectureDecision.rationale: It is the only option that preserves the strongest observed discovery recall without entrusting nondeterministic AI or recall-destroying deterministic vetoes with canonical truth. Human review owns uncertainty; persisted approved maps preserve deterministic, zero-AI runtime reads.

recommendedNextTaskDetail.name: DESIGN REVIEW-ROUTING CONTRACT
recommendedNextTaskDetail.scope: Specify candidate IDs, evidence fields, exact state transitions, conservative initial auto-accept rules, review manifest shape, idempotency/retry semantics, and benchmark arithmetic. Recompute no production maps and make no AI calls.
recommendedNextTaskDetail.whyNext: The architecture decision is clear, but the exact C review burden and safe auto-accept boundary are not. This is the smallest task that can turn V10G's zero-FP evidence into a testable contract without restarting deterministic mapper research.
